newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yukong sets US$75 mln term loan.
newsitem.headline: Yukong sets US$75 mln term loan.

text.p: South Korean oil refiner Yukong Ltd has launched a US$75 million term loan facility, arranger Westdeutsche Landesbank Asia Pacific said.
The facility has a final maturity of three years. It pays a margin of 39.5 basis points over the three- or six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Repayment of the loan will be in bullet form.

Fees are 30 basis points for co-arrangers committing to US$6 million or more, 27.5 basis points for lead managers committing to US$4-5 million, and 25 basis points for managers committing to US$2-3 million.
The other arrangers are Chase Manhattan Asia, Korea Development Bank, Sakura Finance Asia and Sumitomo Bank.
Chase Manhattan Asia, Sakura Finance Asia and Sumitomo Bank are bookrunners.
Korea Development Bank is facility agent.
Proceeds of the loan will be used for overseas investment and for refinancing existing debt.
